verdict.rationale: Superpowers says its skills trigger automatically from context, with no special invocation needed (gh-11). A SessionStart bootstrap tells the agent to invoke relevant skills before any response (docs-16, docs-26, docs-28), and a task-to-skill routing example maps "Fix this bug" to systematic-debugging (docs-77). Skill wording is engineered through TDD-style pressure scenarios and an eval harness that judges skill compliance across Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI (docs-15, docs-76, docs-14). Auto-triggering is also documented across other harnesses (docs-7, gh-8, docs-59). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how each skill's description/frontmatter is written to drive selection, and independent or hands-on evidence that the right skill actually fires at the right moment.
